theorem cq_agree_ih [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) (t1 n1 t2 n2
    i : w64) (G1 G2 : List EntryM) : uint.Z t1 < uint.Z T → uint.Z t2 < uint.Z T → uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z
    n1 → uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z n2 → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t1 n1 G1 -∗ cq γ t2 n2 G2 -∗ ⌜∀ (j : w64),
    uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i → plogTermAt base0 G1 j = plogTermAt base0 G2 j⌝

theorem winner_campDyn [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (c T : w64) (V : GSet w64) (F0 :
    List EntryM) (k : w64) (Hdyn : γ.reDyn ≠ none) (Hne : ∃ v, v ∈ V) : ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ ([∗map] x ↦
    _u ∈ toMap V, isVote γ x T c) -∗ isCampK γ c T F0 k -∗ ∃ tmc, ⌜uint.Z tmc < uint.Z T ∧ ConfI1 F0
    (uint.Z k).toNat ∧ PlogWf base0 F0⌝ ∗ logRecs γ base0 F0 ∗ commitIn γ F0 k tmc

theorem camp_last (T : w64) (F0 : List EntryM) : CampOk T F0 → plogTermAt base0 F0 (W64
    (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast base0 F0).term'

theorem fire_one [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (G : List EntryM) (m : Nat) (e : EntryM)
    : PlogWf base0 G → G[m]? = some e → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 G -∗ commitSt γ (List.take m G) ={⊤ \
    ↑raftN}=∗ commitSt γ (List.take (m + 1) G)

theorem lc_core [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (k : Nat) (T t n : w64) (F : List EntryM)
    (c : w64) (F0 G : List EntryM) : uint.Z T < ↑k → uint.Z t < uint.Z T → PlogWf base0 G →
    plogTermAt base0 G (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast base0 F0).term' → ⊢ votesTbl
    γ -∗ cq γ t n F -∗ isLeader γ c T -∗ isCamp γ c T F0 -∗ logRecs γ base0 G -∗ ⌜plogTermAt base0 G
    n = some t⌝

theorem rlq_join [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l1 l2 : List EntryM) : ⊢ ghostVar
    γ.reRLog rlq l1 -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog rlq l2 -∗ ⌜l1 = l2⌝ ∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l1

theorem commit_extend [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t n : w64) (G : List EntryM) (ldr :
    w64) : ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ regsOwn γ -∗ cq γ t n G -∗ isLeader γ ldr t -∗ cmtLb γ ldr t n ={⊤ \
    ↑raftRegN}=∗ regsOwn γ ∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z n).toNat G)

def commitSt [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownCommitted γ l ∗ entsData γ l ∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) l ∗ regsAt γ l)

theorem cq_agree [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (t1 n1 t2 n2 i : w64) (G1 G2 : List
    EntryM) : uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z n1 → uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z n2 → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t1 n1 G1 -∗ cq γ t2
    n2 G2 -∗ ⌜∀ (j : w64), uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i → plogTermAt base0 G1 j = plogTermAt base0 G2 j⌝

theorem cq_lt_agree_ih [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) (t1 n1 t2
    n2 : w64) (G1 G2 : List EntryM) : uint.Z t1 < uint.Z t2 → uint.Z t2 < uint.Z T → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗
    cq γ t1 n1 G1 -∗ cq γ t2 n2 G2 -∗ ⌜∀ (j : w64), uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z n1 → plogTermAt base0 G1 j =
    plogTermAt base0 G2 j⌝

theorem take_snoc_le.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} (l : List A) (e : A) (n : Nat) (h : n ≤ l.length) :
    List.take n (l ++ [e]) = List.take n l

theorem bigSepL_fupd_thread.{u_1} [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {A : Type u_1} (E : CoPset) (R : IProp
    GF) (Φ Ψ : A → IProp GF) (l : List A) : ⊢ (□ ∀ x, R -∗ Φ x ={E}=∗ R ∗ Ψ x) -∗ R -∗ ([∗list] x ∈
    l, Φ x) ={E}=∗ R ∗ [∗list] x ∈ l, Ψ x

theorem fire_upto_open [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (G : List EntryM) (d m : Nat) :
    PlogWf base0 G → m + d ≤ G.length → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 G -∗ commitSt γ (List.take m G) ={(⊤ \
    ↑raftRegN) \ ↑raftLogN}=∗ commitSt γ (List.take (m + d) G)

theorem lc_far_newer [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t n : w64) (F : List EntryM) (a :
    w64) (F0 G : List EntryM) (kw tmc : w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) : uint.Z t < uint.Z T → uint.Z tmc <
    uint.Z T → PlogWf base0 G → plogTermAt base0 G (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast
    base0 F0).term' → CampOk T F0 → uint.Z kw ≤ plogLastIndexZ base0 F0 → ConfI1 F (uint.Z a).toNat
    → confCount (List.take (uint.Z a).toNat F) + 2 ≤ confCount (List.take (uint.Z kw).toNat F0) → ⊢
    votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t n F -∗ logRecs γ base0 F0 -∗ commitIn γ F0 kw tmc -∗ logRecs γ base0 G -∗
    ⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some t⌝

theorem entDataIs_deposited [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (e : EntryM) (d : List w8) :
    entDataIs γ e (some d) ⊢ deposited γ d

    base0 G → m + d ≤ G.length → ⊢ logRecs γ base0 G -∗ commitSt γ (List.take m G) ={⊤ \ ↑raftN}=∗
    commitSt γ (List.take (m + d) G)

theorem lc_adj_gen [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t n : w64) (F : List EntryM) (c :
    w64) (F0 G : List EntryM) (q V : GSet w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) : uint.Z t < uint.Z T → PlogWf base0
    G → plogTermAt base0 G (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast base0 F0).term' → (∃ v,
    v ∈ q ∧ v ∈ V) → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t n F -∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃ i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤
    uint.Z i'⌝ ∗ isAcked γ v t i')) -∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap V, isVote γ v T c) -∗ (□ ∀ ldr qd,
    isWin γ ldr T qd -∗ ⌜∃ v, v ∈ V ∧ ¬v ∈ qd⌝ -∗ □ ∀ X' j', votesTbl γ -∗ leadFull γ T X' -∗
    ⌜uint.Z j' ≤ uint.Z n ∧ (plogTermAt base0 X' j').isSome = true⌝ -∗ ⌜plogTermAt base0 X' j' =
    plogTermAt base0 F j'⌝) -∗ isCamp γ c T F0 -∗ logRecs γ base0 G -∗ ⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some
    t⌝

theorem depSlot_grow [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq γt : GName) (l :
    List EntryM) (e : EntryM) : depSlot γ d γq γt l ⊢ depSlot γ d γq γt (l ++ [e])

theorem winTbl_insert [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T : w64) (c : CfgM) (V : GSet
    w64) : ⊢ winTbl γ -∗ votesTbl γ -∗ isWinCore γ id T c V ==∗ winTbl γ ∗ votesTbl γ ∗ isWin γ id T
    V

theorem getElem?_snoc_cases.{u_1} {A : Type u_1} {l : List A} {e e' : A} {m : Nat} (h : (l ++
    [e])[m]? = some e') : m < l.length ∧ l[m]? = some e' ∧ List.take m (l ++ [e]) = List.take m l ∨
    m = l.length ∧ e' = e ∧ List.take m (l ++ [e]) = l

theorem vote_insert [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id : w64) (γv : GName) (voted : GMap
    w64 w64) (T c : w64) : γ.reVotes !! id = some γv → voted !! T = none → ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗
    voteJust γ id T c -∗ ghostMapAuth γv (Qp.half 1) voted ={⊤ \ ↑raftRegN}=∗ ghostMapAuth γv
    (Qp.half 1) <[T := c]>voted ∗ T ↪[γv]□ c

    EntryM) (e : EntryM) : ⊢ readSlot γ r l -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [e]) ={⊤ \
    ↑raftN}=∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [e]) ∗ readSlot γ r (l ++ [e])

theorem tbl_voter [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (v T c t i : w64) : uint.Z t < uint.Z T
    → 0 < uint.Z i → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ isVote γ v T c -∗ isAcked γ v t i -∗ ∃ d Fv Fc, isCamp γ c T Fc
    ∗ logRecs γ base0 Fv ∗ ⌜PlogWf base0 Fv ∧ plogUpToDate base0 Fv (plogLast base0 Fc) = true⌝ ∗
    hist γ Fv t i (vbnd T d) ∗ if d = true then ∃ ldr q, isWin γ ldr T q ∗ ⌜¬v ∈ q⌝ else True

    List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (o : Option (List w8)) (Hne : o ≠ some d) : ⊢ entDataIs γ e o -∗
    propSlot γ d p l -∗ propSlot γ d p (l ++ [e])

    EntryM) : uint.Z t1 < uint.Z t2 → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t1 n1 G1 -∗ cq γ t2 n2 G2 -∗ ⌜∀ (j :

    (Qp.half 1) l -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog rlq l ∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog rlq l

    w64) : ⊢ raftCommitInv γ -∗ isWinCore γ id T c V ={⊤ \ ↑raftRegN}=∗ isWin γ id T V

theorem prefix_camp_last (T : w64) (F0 X : List EntryM) : CampOk T F0 → F0 <+: X → plogTermAt base0
    X (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast base0 F0).term'

theorem bigSepM_fupd_thread [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] {K V : Type} [DecidableEq K] [Pos.Countable K]
    (E : CoPset) (R : IProp GF) (Φ Ψ : K → V → IProp GF) (M : GMap K V) : ⊢ (□ ∀ k v, R -∗ Φ k v
    ={E}=∗ R ∗ Ψ k v) -∗ R -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ v ∈ M, Φ k v) ={E}=∗ R ∗ [∗map] k ↦ v ∈ M, Ψ k v

    List EntryM) (e : EntryM) : ⊢ qRes p.fst l -∗ propSlotRes γ d p l -∗ (∃ K, ghostMapAuth p.snd 1
    K ∗ [∗map] γt ∈ K, depSlot γ d p.fst γt (l ++ [e])) -∗ propSlot γ d p (l ++ [e])

theorem deps_grow [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (d : List w8) (γq : GName) (K : GMap Nat
    GName) (l : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) : ([∗map] γt ∈ K, depSlot γ d γq γt l) ⊢ [∗map] γt ∈ K,
    depSlot γ d γq γt (l ++ [e])

theorem win_fresh [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (id T : w64) (c : CfgM) (V : GSet w64) :
    ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ isWinCore γ id T c V -∗ ∀ id' c' q', isWinCore γ id' T c' q' -∗ T ↪[γ.reTbl]□
    ((id', c'), q') -∗ ⌜∃ v, v ∈ V ∧ v ∈ q'⌝

theorem lc_adj [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t n : w64) (F : List EntryM) (c : w64)
    (F0 G : List EntryM) (q V : GSet w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) : uint.Z t < uint.Z T → PlogWf base0 G →
    plogTermAt base0 G (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0)) = some (plogLast base0 F0).term' → (∃ v, v ∈
    q ∧ v ∈ V) → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cq γ t n F -∗ ([∗map] v ↦ _u ∈ toMap q, iprop(∃ i', ⌜uint.Z n ≤
    uint.Z i'⌝ ∗ isAcked γ v t i')) -∗ isWin γ c T V -∗ isCamp γ c T F0 -∗ logRecs γ base0 G -∗
    ⌜plogTermAt base0 G n = some t⌝

def LcIH [ReceiptGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T : w64) : Prop :=
  ∀ (T' t' n' : w64) (F' : List EntryM) (c' : w64) (F0' G' : List EntryM),
    uint.Z T' < uint.Z T →
      uint.Z t' < uint.Z T' →
        PlogWf base0 G' →
          plogTermAt base0 G' (W64 (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0')) = some (plogLast base0 F0').term' →
            ⊢
              votesTbl γ -∗
                cq γ t' n' F' -∗
                  isLeader γ c' T' -∗ isCamp γ c' T' F0' -∗ logRecs γ base0 G' -∗ ⌜plogTermAt base0 G' n' = some t'⌝

theorem lc_far_older [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (T t : w64) (F : List EntryM) (a c :
    w64) (F0 : List EntryM) (kw : w64) (cW : CfgM) (V : GSet w64) (IH : LcIH γ T) : uint.Z t <
    uint.Z T → CampOk T F0 → ConfI1 F0 (uint.Z kw).toNat → CfgAt γ (List.take (uint.Z kw).toNat F0)
    cW → JQuorum cW V → confCount (List.take (uint.Z kw).toNat F0) + 2 ≤ confCount (List.take
    (uint.Z a).toNat F) → γ.reBoot <+: F → ⊢ votesTbl γ -∗ cqDyn γ t F a -∗ isWin γ c T V -∗ isCamp
    γ c T F0 -∗ logRecs γ base0 F0 -∗ isCommitted γ (List.take (uint.Z kw).toNat F0) -∗ False

theorem readsReg_fire [ReceiptGS GF] [InvGS GF] (γ : RaftNames) (l : List EntryM) (e : EntryM) (RR :
    GMap (List w8) (GName × List EntryM)) : ⊢ readsReg γ l RR -∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++
    [e]) ={⊤ \ ↑raftN}=∗ ghostVar γ.reRLog (Qp.half 1) (l ++ [e]) ∗ readsReg γ (l ++ [e]) RR
